streaming.liveText: ## Specification: Overlay Web Benchmark NoteStore### Project ContextThis is a greenfield implementation in a fresh TypeScript project scaffold. The project uses:- Runtime: Bun (already available)- Test Framework: bun:test (built-in Bun test runner)- Module System: ES Modules ("type": "module" in package.json)- TypeScript: Strict mode enabled with ES2022 targetNo existing TypeScript files are present in the src/ directory. This is a clean implementation task.### Requirements#### 1. Note Interface (src/note-store.ts)Export a Note interface with the following structure:export interface Note {  id: string;  title: string;  done: boolean;  created_at: number;}- id: UUID string generated via crypto.randomUUID()- title: The note's title (trimmed of whitespace)- done: Boolean flag indicating completion status- created_at: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) from Date.now()#### 2. NoteStore Class (src/note-store.ts)Export a NoteStore class backed by an in-memory Map<string, Note>:Constructor: Initialize the internal Map storage.Methods:| Method | Signature | Behavior ||--------|-----------|----------|| create | (title: string) => Note | Trim title, throw Error if empty after trim, generate UUID via crypto.randomUUID(), set done=false, created_at=Date.now(), store in Map, return the Note || get | (id: string) => Note \| undefined | Return the Note if exists, otherwise undefined || list | () => Note[] | Return all notes sorted by created_at ascending (oldest first) || toggle | (id: string) => Note \| undefined | Flip the done boolean, return updated Note or undefined if not found || remove | (id: string) => boolean | Delete the note from Map, return true if deleted, false if not found |#### 3. Test Coverage (src/note-store.test.ts)Use bun:test framework with import { expect, test, describe } from "bun:test".Required test cases:1. create returns a complete Note: Verify that create() returns an object with all required properties (id, title, done, created_at) with correct types and values.2. empty title throws: Verify that create("") and create("   ") (whitespace-only) throw an Error.3. list preserves creation order: Create multiple notes and verify list() returns them sorted by created_at ascending.4. toggle flips done: Create a note, toggle it, verify done flips from false to true, toggle again to verify it flips back.5. remove deletes successfully: Create a note, remove it, verify remove() returns true, then verify get() returns undefined for that id.### Constraints- File restriction: Only modify/create src/note-store.ts and src/note-store.test.ts. Do not add package.json, tsconfig.json, README, or any other files.- No external dependencies: Use only built-in Bun APIs (crypto.randomUUID(), bun:test).- Code comments: Add clear comments explaining intent and non-obvious logic (per code_comments preference).- Cohesive design: Keep all NoteStore logic in a single class with the Map as private internal state (per code_design_principle preference).- No workarounds: Implement proper error handling for empty titles, not temporary fixes (per problem_solving_approach preference).### Technical Designsrc/note-store.ts structure:// Note interface definitionexport interface Note { ... }// NoteStore classexport class NoteStore {  private store: Map<string, Note>;    constructor() { ... }  create(title: string): Note { ... }  get(id: string): Note | undefined { ... }  list(): Note[] { ... }  toggle(id: string): Note | undefined { ... }  remove(id: string): boolean { ... }}src/note-store.test.ts structure:import { expect, test, describe } from "bun:test";import { NoteStore } from "./note-store";describe("NoteStore", () => {  describe("create", () => { ... });  describe("get", () => { ... });  describe("list", () => { ... });  describe("toggle", () => { ... });  describe("remove", () => { ... });});### Acceptance Criteria1. Running bun test ./src/note-store.test.ts exits with code 0 (all tests pass)2. The Note interface is exported from src/note-store.ts with correct type signature3. The NoteStore class is exported with all five required methods4. All five test cases specified in requirements are implemented and passing5. Code includes appropriate comments explaining key logic decisions### Out-of-Scope- Adding package.json scripts or configuration changes- Adding README documentation (task explicitly restricts to two files)- Persistent storage (in-memory Map only)- Additional methods beyond create, get, list, toggle, remove- Update/modify method for changing title or other properties- Search or filter functionality
